lines.text: Jesus returned to Capernaum, and so many people gathered that there was no room, not even outside the door.
Four men carried a paralytic to Jesus and lowered him on his mat through the roof.
When Jesus saw their pride, He told the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven."
Some scribes thought Jesus was blaspheming, since only God can forgive sins, and Jesus knew this in His spirit.
The man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out, and everyone was frightened and glorified God.
